test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. The old man (A)/ died for(B) / a heart attack(C)/today(D).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the preposition used with the verb "died" in part **B**: "**died for**".
 
• The correct preposition to use with "died" in this context is "**of**" when referring to the cause of death (e.g., "died of a heart attack").
 
• "Died for" is used when referring to a cause or purpose (e.g., "died for his country"), not a medical reason.
 
• Thus, the phrase should be "**died of** a heart attack."
 
• Therefore, the error is located in **part B** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The old man **died of** a heart attack today."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "The old man"** – This segment is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "a heart attack"** – This segment is correct as it is the object of the correct preposition "of."
 
• **D: "today"** – This segment is correct as an adverb of time.
 
• **No error** – This would be chosen if there were no mistakes, but there is a clear error in part B.
